bio.en: By its own description, Zumar aims to translate books that benefit the nation and the Muslim community and offer them to readers. It mainly publishes religious and educational books: a series of works by Abu Hamid al-Ghazali (Taqvo, Tavba, Sabr va shukr), books about the Companions and the Tabi'un, and translations of Turkish authors. It runs the Zumar bookshop in Tashkent.

It publishes classic and modern Uzbek literature (Abdulla Qodiriy, Abdulla Qahhor, O'tkir Hoshimov, Usmon Azim), translations of world literature (Chingiz Aytmatov, Chekhov, Pushkin, Kafka), as well as dictionaries, study books and religious titles.

Оно выпускает научную, учебную и религиозную литературу по исламоведению, в том числе «Правила таджвида», «Семь книг из „Хидаи“», «Этику мира и религии» аль-Маварди и перевод «Маснави» Джалалиддина Руми.
bio.en: The Tashkent Islamic University press was founded in 2000 and in 2018 became part of the publishing and printing association of the International Islamic Academy of Uzbekistan. It publishes academic, educational and religious literature on Islamic studies, including 'Rules of Tajwid', 'Seven Books from al-Hidaya', al-Mawardi's 'Ethics of This World and Religion' and a translation of Rumi's Masnavi.

note: The channel belongs to the successor academy (press service), not a book channel. Consider renaming the publisher or noting the succession. Catalogue name has a typo: 'Universititeti' -> 'universiteti'.

bio.en: The Imam Bukhari International Research Center was established in 2017 under the Cabinet of Ministers of Uzbekistan. It also publishes Islamic books, including Muhammad Salim Bukhari's 'Durrat al-Wa'izin' (in Uzbek and Russian), 'Questions and Answers in Islam', 'Pure Islamic Creed' and Osman Nuri Topbaş's 'Enduring Righteous Deeds'.
